title: Storage Tenant Discount on the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental First-Day Fee
content:
**Storage tenant terms.** The Bluegate Moving Truck Rental first-day tenant discount depends on the renter's storage agreements, read from the renter's Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records (status, facility and move-in date), with months counted as whole calendar months before the handling date — the date on which the first-day fee is worked out:

- a renter whose active storage agreement at the pickup facility moved in **24** or more calendar months before the handling date takes a discount of **0.15**;
- a renter whose active storage agreement at the pickup facility moved in at least **6** but fewer than 24 months before takes **0.1**;
- any other renter takes no tenant discount.

The discount is a fraction of the day-rated first-day fee. Where more than one first-day discount fraction applies, the fractions are added together first and taken off the day-rated fee in a single step, never one after another, and the fee is rounded to the cent once at the end.

## Month boundaries (hypothetical handling dates; active agreement at the pickup facility)

| Move-in date | Handling date | Whole calendar months | Tenant discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2024 | 9 March 2026 | 23 | 0.1 |
| 10 March 2024 | 10 March 2026 | 24 | 0.15 |
| 10 September 2025 | 9 March 2026 | 5 | None |
| 10 September 2025 | 10 March 2026 | 6 | 0.1 |

An agreement at a different facility, or one that is not active, gives no tenant discount.

Worked figure (hypothetical): a day-rated fee of 29.94 with a tenant discount of 0.15 and one other first-day discount of 0.05 takes 0.2 off in one step, giving 23.952, which rounds to 23.95.
